shots.title: Overview
shots.caption: Health, readiness and current setup on one screen.

shots.title: Gestures
shots.caption: Pen buttons and motions mapped to pointer, drag, pan and scroll.
shots.alt: Kinetip gestures page with activation modes and pen feel sliders

shots.title: Momentum
shots.caption: Scroll inertia drawn as a curve you can tune.

shots.title: Mapping
shots.caption: Choose the active area on the tablet and see where it lands on screen.

shots.title: Usage insights
shots.caption: Where the pen spends its time on the tablet surface.
shots.alt: Kinetip usage insights page with a heatmap of pen activity

shots.title: Energy
shots.caption: Hourly consumption across the day, with the evening peak.
shots.alt: Habitat energy widget charting hourly consumption for the whole house, heat pump and studio

shots.title: Temperatures
shots.caption: Every room in its own colour, last six hours.
shots.alt: Habitat temperature chart in dark mode with colour-coded lines for five rooms

shots.title: Power
shots.caption: Spot the oven spike at a glance.
shots.alt: Habitat power widget with whole house, heat pump, studio and fridge traces and one large spike

shots.title: Gauges
shots.caption: Humidity, commute time, outside temperature and battery levels.
shots.alt: Habitat gauges widget with circular readings for humidity, commute, outside temperature, door battery and air filter

shots.caption: Open the stack to see every file, size and status.
shots.alt: Ledge shelf expanded into a grid of five items with their names and sizes

shots.caption: Progress and cancel stay on the shelf while files copy.

shots.title: Watched folders
shots.caption: Disks, shares and folders that put new files on a shelf.
shots.alt: Ledge settings page listing watched folders with their status

shots.title: The wheel
shots.caption: Point at a category, release, and the phrase lands where you type.
shots.alt: Spoke radial menu with categories Email, Message, Reply, Schedule, Request, Thanks, Social and Snippets

shots.title: Usage
shots.caption: See which phrases you reach for most.
shots.alt: Spoke usage page ranking Follow up, Thank you, Introduce yourself and Politely decline by use

shots.caption: Levels, LUFS and spectrum for every output, from the menu bar.

shots.caption: The same panel in dark mode, meters and all.
